Hermann Grassmann publicó en 1844 la teo: In 1844 Hermann Grassmann published the theory of vector spaces of arbitrary dimension, fifty years before anybody needed it. The book was so badly written and so abstract that practically nobody read it; discouraged, Grassmann abandoned mathematics and became a linguist, going on to be a Sanskrit scholar of some standing. His mathematical work was rediscovered when twentieth-century physics began to need spaces of many dimensions.
